claim: In the matching retail DLL, static Menu_SoundManager.IsPlaying_BGM (0x060052A0) and Menu_SoundManager.IsPlay_RefereeVoice (0x060052AA) are exact 20-byte Boolean query methods with the same structure and different fixed audioSrcInfo slots. IsPlaying_BGM has raw MethodDef row 0829320000009600aa600a00634a00002a3d, RVA 0x00322908, signature blob 000002, code SHA-256 f443c2451dd1f05f72b0fdf52010f2bdf11af076ba3d8cd82f5d819114b82b62; it loads static audioSrcInfo (0x040086EB), selects raw index 0, stores the AudioSrcInfo in local0, loads local0.sRefAudio (0x0400874C), calls UnityEngine.AudioSource.get_isPlaying (0x0A000CAE), and returns the Boolean. IsPlay_RefereeVoice has raw MethodDef row a02c32000000960028610a00634a0000373d, RVA 0x00322CA0, signature blob 000002, code SHA-256 73b973ba207b6764e96da5c8b6513177be2d821c9f0bbbdf234ebd4d13290b2c; it performs the identical flow using raw audioSrcInfo index 4. Both fat headers have maxstack 2 and the same local signature token 0x1100120B, blob 070112aa2c, declaring one AudioSrcInfo local. A matching-DLL body scan finds one direct call to IsPlaying_BGM from Referee.PostProcessAnimation (0x0600507F) at IL+0x041F and one direct call to IsPlay_RefereeVoice from Dialog_Scroll.Update (0x060026A4) at IL+0x007D; those caller bodies are not closed by this fact, so the references are recorded as raw caller observations rather than canonical chain edges.

evidence.locator: Menu_SoundManager.IsPlaying_BGM token 0x060052A0 RVA 0x00322908 size 20 sha256=f443c2451dd1f05f72b0fdf52010f2bdf11af076ba3d8cd82f5d819114b82b62; Menu_SoundManager.IsPlay_RefereeVoice token 0x060052AA RVA 0x00322CA0 size 20 sha256=73b973ba207b6764e96da5c8b6513177be2d821c9f0bbbdf234ebd4d13290b2c; exact raw-slot/audio-source/isPlaying queries plus direct caller observations in canonical/witnesses/CAP-R6-001/menu_sound_playing_queries.summary.json; prover tools/prove_menu_sound_playing_queries.py
